prompt:
You are one role in an autonomous ML research agent for KuaiRand-Pure.
The immutable task is within-user ranking of long_view using validation GAUC and nDCG@5.
Use train and validation only. Never request or infer hidden-test information. Do not change
the official evaluator, split, label, budgets, or reference files. Return only the requested
structured output. Evidence must be attributable to a supplied method card or primary source.
Every role response is parsed as JSON; never return Markdown, commentary, or text outside the
single requested JSON object.

EDA roles produce compact planning/report artifacts only. They do not generate candidate.py,
modify raw data, change evaluators, or inspect hidden-test data. Prefer train-only evidence
and leakage-safe feature hypotheses compatible with registered families: bpr, group_softmax, history_features, multi_task.

## Data Quality

- 239 videos with zero duration (24,076 train rows affected)
- 15,609 exact duplicate rows in the training-period log
- Sentinel: is_live_streamer = -124 on 21,127 of 27,285 user rows
- UNKNOWN values: user_active_degree (6), video_type (1), upload_type (80)
- Constant columns: is_lowactive_period, visible_status, is_rand
- hourmin encodes hour times 100 in UTC+8
- The training-period log begins on 20220409, not 20220408

## Feature Coverage

- Video features: 100.000 % of train+valid video IDs found in the feature table
- User features: 100.000 % of train+valid user IDs found in the profile table

## Leakage Flag

The video statistics table is a period aggregate over full-platform traffic.
Implied total shows: 12.83 B vs 2.62 M logged
exposures (ratio approximately 4,892 to one). Observation periods per video
range 45 to 181, exceeding the interaction log span.
Legal for use, but any feature derived from it must be caveated as leaky.

## Metric Conventions

- Task: within-user ranking (each user's impressions ranked against each other)
- nDCG@5: sorts by score with a stable sort (ties fall back to row order)
- AUC: averages ranks over ties (Mann-Whitney U)
- GAUC: per-user AUC, only users with 0 < positives < impressions,
  weighted by positive count
- Zero-positive users: nDCG recorded as 0.0 and included in the average
- Primary score = mean(GAUC, nDCG@5)

## Measured Dead Ends

- Adding all 13 static feature fields: primary 0.5940 vs 0.5950 for the default 5
- Embedding dimension k = 8 / 16 / 32: primary 0.5895 / 0.5902 / 0.5887 (flat)
- The bottleneck is not features or capacity
- First-order user-only terms contribute exactly 0 to within-user ranking
  (any term constant within a user does not change intra-group ordering)


ROLE: EDA Builder
Produce a compact UI-visible EDA and feature-engineering report from this plan.
You may infer only from the supplied DATA CARD and experiment history; do not invent exact statistics that are not present.
Separate observations from implications. Every feature candidate must state implementation scope and leakage risk.
Favor feature candidates compatible with src.models.features, history_features, multi_task, BPR, or group_softmax.
Return concise JSON: at most 3 findings, 3 feature candidates, and 3 UI notes. One sentence per field.

feature_candidates.description: Categorical interaction of tab (0-14) with binned hour (e.g., 4-hour buckets) to capture context-specific engagement patterns.
feature_candidates.expected_impact: High; tab alone has large rate differences, hour may add recency/fatigue effects.
feature_candidates.implementation_scope: Add as a feature embedding in candidate.py; requires mapping tab and hourmin to bucket indices.
feature_candidates.leakage_risk: Low; tab and hour are observed at exposure time, no future info.
feature_candidates.name: tab_hour_bucket_interaction

feature_candidates.description: Train-only prefix-computed rate of user's past long_view per video category (or tag), updated per exposure.
feature_candidates.expected_impact: Moderate; captures user preferences and may improve ranking within user.
feature_candidates.implementation_scope: Compute on-the-fly during training using train-only interactions; store per-user, per-category counters.
feature_candidates.leakage_risk: High if computed over full log; must be strictly prefix (only prior exposures) to avoid future leakage.
feature_candidates.name: user_history_longview_rate_per_category

feature_candidates.description: Use is_like, is_comment, is_forward as auxiliary targets in a multi-task loss to sharpen long_view representation.
feature_candidates.expected_impact: Moderate; auxiliary labels share user intent and could regularize the main objective.
feature_candidates.implementation_scope: Add auxiliary heads and combine losses; available labels in train; no change to primary label.
feature_candidates.leakage_risk: Low; labels are contemporaneous with long_view and do not include future info.
feature_candidates.name: multi_task_auxiliary_labels

findings.evidence: DATA CARD tab breakdown (train) shows wide rate differences across tabs.
findings.implication: Including tab as a categorical feature (or per-tab user history) should improve ranking significantly.
findings.observation: Long_view rate varies dramatically by tab: tab 4 at 48.93%, tab 1 at 38.61%, tab 0 at 4.22% (train).
findings.title: Tab position is a strong categorical predictor

findings.evidence: DATA CARD 'Data Quality' section lists zero-duration and duplicate counts.
findings.implication: Univariate correlation analyses should exclude or flag these rows to avoid spurious estimates.
findings.observation: 239 videos with zero duration (24,076 rows) and 15,609 exact duplicate rows exist in train log.
findings.title: Data quality issues can bias correlations

findings.evidence: DATA CARD 'Rows per User' percentile and leakage risk note on user history features.
findings.implication: Build history features using only prior logged exposures per user to avoid future leakage.
findings.observation: Users have median 34 rows (p50), providing enough history for aggregates, but validation-period rows must be excluded from history computation.
findings.title: User history requires train-only prefix windows

data.recommended_next_focus: Run a univariate logistic regression on cleaned train data (excluding leaky video stats) to confirm tab and hour effects, then implement tab interaction and prefix-based history features.
data.summary: EDA plan focuses on leakage-safe analysis of tab/hour/user-history features and multi-task auxiliary labels to lift within-user long_view ranking from 0.6016, using train-only aggregates and cleaning duplicate/zero-duration rows.
ui_notes: Tab 4 (48.93% long_view) vs tab 0 (4.22%) is a huge gap; consider separate tab embeddings.
Remove zero-duration and duplicate rows before any correlation analysis to avoid bias.
Do not use the leaky video stats table until designing a decaying popularity feature with exposure-count controls.
